title: Two verses with labels and syllable types
description: Two half notes carrying two verse lines. Verse one is whole words; verse two splits "Morning" across both notes with type start and end — the hyphen the renderer draws between them is derived from those types, not typed into the text. The global lyrics block orders the lines and labels them 1. and 2.; the labels are carried but not drawn yet, so the goldens pin the two stacked verse rows with a hyphen and no verse numbers.
